Arrange a query to find teachers with more than 8 years of experience
Find the maximum experience among all teachers
Arrange a query to list teachers ordered by their experience in descending order
Find the average years of experience of all teachers
Arrange a query to count how many teachers teach each unique subject
List each student's name along with their assigned teacher's name
arguments: SELECT s.student_name, t.teacher_name FROM students s INNER JOIN teachers t ON s.teacher_id = t.teacher_id;

question: Arrange an INNER JOIN query to find students taught by 'Anjali Sharma'
Find all students who are being taught by a teacher with more than 9 years of experience
arguments: SELECT s.student_name FROM students s INNER JOIN teachers t ON s.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE t.experience > 9;

question: Arrange a query to count the number of students assigned to each teacher
Find teachers whose names start with the letter 'P'
arguments: SELECT * FROM teachers WHERE teacher_name LIKE 'P%';

question: Arrange a query to find subjects taught by teachers who have experience between 5 and 10 years
Find the total experience of teachers who teach either 'Physics' or 'Chemistry'
arguments: SELECT SUM(experience) FROM teachers WHERE subject IN ('Physics', 'Chemistry');

question: Arrange a subquery to select student details whose teacher is 'Rajesh Kumar'
Find the subject taught to the student named 'Arjun Mehta'
arguments: SELECT t.subject FROM teachers t INNER JOIN students s ON t.teacher_id = s.teacher_id WHERE s.student_name = 'Arjun Mehta';

question: Find all teachers who have strictly more experience than 'Priya Singh'
arguments: SELECT * FROM teachers WHERE experience > (SELECT experience FROM teachers WHERE teacher_name = 'Priya Singh');

question: Arrange a query to find the average age of students grouped by their class
Find the name and subject of the teacher assigned to student 'Sneha Patel'
arguments: SELECT t.teacher_name, t.subject FROM teachers t INNER JOIN students s ON t.teacher_id = s.teacher_id WHERE s.student_name = 'Sneha Patel';

question: Arrange a subquery to find students whose age is strictly greater than the average student age
Count how many students are exactly 14 years old
arguments: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE age = 14;

question: Arrange a query to list teachers who have NO students assigned to them
Find teachers whose subject names contain 'math' (case-insensitive pattern search)
arguments: SELECT * FROM teachers WHERE subject ILIKE '%math%';

question: Arrange a query to find students whose teacher has more than 10 years of experience
Find the average age of all students taught by 'Anjali Sharma'
arguments: SELECT AVG(s.age) FROM students s INNER JOIN teachers t ON s.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE t.teacher_name = 'Anjali Sharma';

question: Arrange a query to order teachers by subject alphabetically, and then by experience descending
Find details of students whose names contain 'Yadav'
arguments: SELECT * FROM students WHERE student_name LIKE '%Yadav%';

question: Arrange a query to count how many students are taught by teachers with less than 10 years of experience
Find the teacher name and subject of the youngest student in the table
arguments: SELECT t.teacher_name, t.subject FROM teachers t INNER JOIN students s ON t.teacher_id = s.teacher_id WHERE s.age = (SELECT MIN(age) FROM students);

question: Arrange a query to select student names in class 10 taught by teacher with ID 1
List all distinct subjects taught to students who are 15 years old
arguments: SELECT DISTINCT t.subject FROM teachers t INNER JOIN students s ON t.teacher_id = s.teacher_id WHERE s.age = 15;
